Oxford University's Pitt Rivers Museum has returned 39 Naga ancestral remains to India, more than a century after they were taken during British colonial rule. The handover took place on November 9, 2026, with representatives of Naga communities travelling to Oxford to reclaim their ancestors. The remains will be brought back to Nagaland for burial at a joint memorial.
Bt this is only one chapter in India's long fight to reclaim its stolen cultural heritage.
